title: EzyShield tier-1 plugin manifest (module.yaml)
description: One plugin under /etc/ezyshield/plugins.d/<name>/module.yaml. A plugin executes ONLY when plugins.enabled is true in config.yaml AND its name is listed in plugins.allow — dropping this file into plugins.d is never enough to run code. The executable must be a relative path inside the plugin directory (no absolute paths, no traversal, no symlinks), a regular file, not world-writable, owned by root or the plugin dir's owner.

name.description: Plugin name. Must equal the directory name and the name in plugins.allow.

version.description: Plugin version string (shown by `ezyshield plugins list`).

type.description: Plugin kind. v1 vocabulary is closed.

exec.description: Executable path RELATIVE to the plugin directory. No PATH lookup, no absolute paths, no '..' traversal, no symlinks.

matches.description: Parser plugins only: source patterns this parser claims.

network.description: Network declaration. ADVISORY in v1: EzyShield does not yet isolate plugin network access — the field exists so authors declare intent and so v2 can enforce it. "none" (default) or a list of hostnames.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout override (Go duration, e.g. "5s"). Hard maximum 30s.
